Castle undercroft corridor between massive round piers, vaulted ceiling pressing low, iron-banded barrel-store doors on both sides, a single torch-bracket at the passage's far end barely burning.
Fishermen's dock lane between low stone curing-houses, iron fish-hooks ranked on wall-brackets above the cobblestones, brine-smell thick in the fog rolling off the unseen harbor beyond.
Narrow back-passage beside a gothic pot-house, an iron grate over the cellar-vent at foot-level, a cracked clay pipe discarded at the threshold, one lantern sputtering above the locked rear door.

Gothic estate ice-house clearing at night, the sunken ice-house mound visible beneath dead grass, a stone-edged ditch around its perimeter, the manor's dark chimney-stacks rising above the tree-line beyond.
Monastery west cloister corner-turn, two arcaded walks meeting at a carved angle-column, the central garth visible through three arches at once, dead leaves banked deep against every column base.

Abandoned night pottery-market in a stone-paved square, broken ceramic shards spread across the cobblestones, empty wooden crate-stacks leaning against the guild-hall wall, one gas-lamp burning overhead.
Ruined gothic tower bell-chamber, the bell fallen and lying cracked on the stone floor below its broken oak frame, fog drifting freely through the completely open arch-openings on all sides.

Ancient stone culvert beneath the city's east gate, its barrel-vaulted ceiling barely clearing a tall man's head, iron-ring lamp-hooks empty and orange-rusted, dark water purling between the hunter's boots.
Ruined castle library, half the shelving collapsed in a spill of rotted leather bindings across the floor, a stone reading-lectern still upright beside a lancet window streaming cold moonlight.

Gaslit cobblestone street cutting between two gothic parish churchyards, iron cemetery-fence on both sides of the lane, a gas-lamp above the central gate-arch casting light onto the moss-wet flagstones.
Gothic cathedral western narthex, a pair of massive stone pillars framing the sealed interior portal, cracked encaustic tiles underfoot, a ring of burned-down votive candles at the pillar bases.
Castle herb-garden courtyard enclosed by the keep's inner walls, stone-edged planting beds overgrown to weeds, a carved stone sundial toppled on its plinth, the keep doorway dark beyond.
Fog-locked monastic graveyard, identical plain stone crosses in precise rows, a broad central path to a sealed stone charnel-house door, dead moss clinging to every cross-face and base.

Gothic guild-hall rooftop ridge-walk between stepped crow-gables, lead valley-gutters channeling the night's rain, a carved stone heraldic beast at the gable-peak directly ahead, fog below on all sides.

Pilgrim forest road between ancient linden columns, iron votive-hooks driven into every trunk at head-height, faded ribbon-offerings rotting on each hook, white fog swallowing the path twenty yards ahead.
